title: Choose the visual world for the Insaan homepage
question: The roll assigned the Fee-Receipt Book. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Palette is pinned by the logo: black gear ring, steel-blue disc, saffron flourishes, leaf green.

options.label: The Fee-Receipt Book
options.lineage: Indian college fee-counter receipt books: carbon duplicates, perforated counterfoils, rubber stamps
options.thesis: The enquiry form is a receipt you fill in and get stamped, the way every family has paid a fee at a college counter.
options.viewport: A receipt book opened flat on a carbon-blue ground: top sheet 'Enquiry No. 0001' with Name and Phone lines, English first, Hindi beneath, saffron stamp poised to say RECEIVED.
options.risk: Can read as bureaucratic if the stamp and handwriting are not warm and confident.

raised.raise: One warm live element: the saffron stamp is the only warm mark on the page and only ever lands on the step the visitor is on.
Reading text stays achromatic black on white sheets; colour lives in the ground, rules, and stamps, never in body copy.
Every line carries a printed serial numeral (No. 0001, Fee Sl. 03) that ties a claim to its detail page.

options.label: The Roll-Number Gazette
options.lineage: Board-result gazettes: newspaper columns of roll numbers printed on result day
options.thesis: Result day, but for admissions: a dense newsprint page where the visitor finds their own line.
options.viewport: A gazette masthead in English and Hindi, columns of programmes and seats, one entry circled in saffron.
options.risk: Familiar territory: most editorial-print directions in education land here, and dense columns are hard on a phone.

options.label: Nixie Counter
options.thesis: Fees, seats, and years as glowing digits in glass tubes on a black chassis.
options.viewport: A bank of tubes reading the founding year 1966 in orange on black, engraved labels underneath.
options.case: Holds clarity: quantities are the interface and the palette already matches the logo's black gear and orange. Loses on audience: it is not a world these families know.
options.risk: Glow effects cost mid-range phones; all figures must stay real or clearly synthetic.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding
options.thesis: The admission journey as a chain of signed decision points, one message per band.
options.viewport: One band: 'Enquire', arrow, '2 minutes', with the next step signed beneath.
options.case: Holds clarity: phones collapse to the single next decision. Fights the logo palette: yellow is not a brand colour here.
options.risk: Yellow would need translating to saffron, which softens the world's signature.

options.label: Neon Circuit
options.case: Loses both: unfamiliar to the audience and a dark room hides fees and eligibility.
options.kept: One live element lit against everything else.

options.label: Iridescent Cloud Edge
options.case: Loses both: pastel iridescence has no link to a 1966 college's identity.
options.kept: Achromatic text field with colour confined to edges.

options.label: Algorave Source Floor
options.case: Loses both: parents and first-generation applicants do not read code.
options.kept: The active line is always visibly the live one.

options.label: Patent Drawing Sheet
options.case: Loses both: exploded technical views explain a machine, not a college.
options.kept: Numbered references tying every claim to its detail.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean college homepage: hero, programs, admissions CTA, done at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Logo, nav, campus photo hero, Enquire button, program cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every neighbouring college by design.
